CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.
   B. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)

   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
